what: Review 1 was refused by drive.ts: 14 to 15 GB free on the boxes' volume, under its 20 GB floor. Box gc kept 48 boxes, many from lanes already merged (p12, ci375), since their tips live only in the box.
cause: Cleanup after a merge removes a box only when its tip is retained in MAIN; a step box whose commit drive re-signed keeps an unsigned tip nobody retains.
